subject: strip::strip_from_match
prompt: In the grep_regex crate (crates/regex), the crate-private function strip::strip_from_match removes the line terminator from a parsed regex. If it changed behaviour, which of the following would behave differently through any chain of calls: (a) public methods of grep_regex's exported types, and (b) functions defined in crates/core/main.rs? Production code only: leave out tests, examples and doc comments. Note that the grep_pcre2 crate has types with the same names; they do not count unless the chain really reaches them. List only entries from (a) and (b), not the intermediate private helpers. Name free functions as module::function using the file's module name (for example main::run), and methods as Type::method.
